text:
maria_sales: Orchid Labs signed the SOW for a 4-week paid POC. They need a capacity plan for eventual enterprise commit. Requirements from their tech lead:
- steady embeddings workload ~600 rps for 10h/day
- ad-hoc marketing bursts up to 3k rps lasting ~90s
- 95th percentile gen latency target <300ms
- data residency + SOC2 and HIPAA questions

owen_se: I'll own traffic shaping and run the smoke tests. Need confirmation on model and sequence lengths. Are they embedding-only or mixed gen+embeds?

maria_sales: Mixed. Mostly embeddings (70%) with short chat responses (~20 tokens avg) for the rest. Model preference is open-source phi-1.8b but they asked about fp16 vs int8 tradeoffs.

sunil_eng: Recommend phi-1.8b-int8 (quantized kernel) for best cost/throughput balance. Measured locally on A100-80GB: embeddings ~1,200 rps/GPU, short chat gen ~90 rps/GPU at steady state with batching. Realistic production numbers after cold start and without cache: embeddings ~850 rps/GPU, gen ~65 rps/GPU. For safety margin, propose 8 reserved GPUs + 4 burst capacity slots. That covers steady 600 rps comfortably and enables short spikes with autoscale.

anya_ops: Ops recommendations:
- Spread reservation across 3 AZs (min 2 GPUs per AZ)
- Reserve a mixed pool: 6x A100 + 2x A10G for lower-cost burst handling
- KV cache TTL = 45m for their workload
- Preheat: run synthetic embedding seeds + typical prompts 20m before expected blast windows
Warmup example command:
```bash
# preheat embedding seeds
for i in $(seq 1 5000); do
  curl -s -X POST \"https://inference.redwood/v1/embeddings?model=phi-1.8b-int8\" -d '{"input": "sample text"}' >/dev/null
done
```
Estimate warmup cost: ~120 GPU-min/day if we do one warm per day. Network egress projected separately.

sunil_eng: Autoscale policy suggestion (tunable after smoke):
```json
{
  "min_reserved": 8,
  "burst_slots": 4,
  "scale_up": {"metric": "rps_per_gpu", "threshold": 0.8, "window_s": 30},
  "scale_down": {"metric": "idle_gpu_fraction", "threshold": 0.6, "window_s": 120},
  "cooldown_s": 90
}
```
Note: rps_per_gpu measured as moving average across pool; threshold 0.8 means add burst when avg utilization >80%.

sam_security: Security checklist from Orchid: customer-managed keys (BYOK), SSO with SCIM provisioning, audit logs export, and endpoint IP allowlist. We can accommodate BYOK — legal needs to finish DPA and KMS cross-account details. Also clarify PHI flow: do they want de-identification before sending to us? If so, we need that in the runbook.

maria_sales: Pricing ask from Orchid: they want a monthly ballpark for committed 8-GPU baseline + 4 burst slots and expected warmup/run costs. Finance: can you help?

infra_bot: Infra note: POC cluster can be provisioned in region us-west-2 tomorrow. Canary slot: 2024-10-08T09:00:00Z. Automated smoke harness available under /ci/poctest/orchid.

ownen_se: Action plan: 1) Sunil to run a 3-hour smoke: steady 600rps + three 90s spikes to 3krps; post perf histograms and max queue depth. 2) Anya to draft preheat runbook and AZ placement matrix. 3) Sam to begin security questionnaire draft and list gating items. 4) Finance to return a monthly estimate with breakout: reserved GPU, burst, warmup, network. I'll invite Orchid SREs to the smoke run.

sunil_eng: Extra note: if Orchid can constrain embedding size to 768-dim and keep sequence tokens < 40 for chat, we can reduce tail latency and potentially drop one GPU from reserve. Worth discussing in the kickoff.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll schedule kickoff with Orchid and share this thread. Keep updates here and post smoke results as soon as available. :white_check_mark:
